title: Remote Control not available on Max plan — --help shows no remote-control option (v2.1.76)
body:
## Environment
- Claude Code version: 2.1.76
- OS: macOS (Darwin 25.3.0, Apple Silicon M4 Pro)
- Subscription: Max plan (Stripe, since 2026-02-06)
- `claude --help | grep -i remote` returns empty
- `claude remote-control` returns: "Remote Control is not yet enabled for your account"

## Expected
Per the docs (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control), Max subscribers should be able to run `claude remote-control` or use `/remote-control` to connect from the Claude iOS app.

## Actual
- `--help` has no remote-control related flags
- `/remote-control` inside session: "not a recognized skill"
- `claude remote-control` from shell: "not yet enabled for your account"
- `hasAvailableSubscription` in `~/.claude.json` shows `false` despite active Max plan

## Request
Please enable the Remote Control feature flag for this account, or advise on any additional steps needed.
author: joshchaotang

This is **not a duplicate** of #33119 — different root cause.

### Already verified:
- No `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` env var
- No `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` env var
- `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` is only present in Claude Code's own subprocess (not user-set)
- `authMethod: claude.ai` (not OAuth)
- `subscriptionType: max`
- Full logout → login cycle done multiple times
